request.text:
labels: The blouse's broad collar spreads across the shoulders and square back, then meets a separate neckerchief at the front V opening.; 블라우스의 넓은 깃이 어깨와 네모난 등판 쪽으로 펼쳐지고 앞 V자 트임에서 별도의 네커치프와 만난다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The blouse's broad collar spreads across the shoulders and square back, then meets a separate neckerchief at the front V opening.
aliases: 세일러 칼라와 목 장식
